name: Ship Desk
tagline: Build it, review it, loop it - an engineering pipeline from real bots.
description: The overnight engineering loop, built from three bots that are live in the directory right now - and the hand-off rule is the whole trick. Apps scaffolds a one-shot web app, PR Reviewer tears into the diff before a human ever sees it, and Loops keeps running the outer build-fix cycle until things pass.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Hand Apps the product idea - it returns a working one-shot Convex web app to start from.

steps.name: Review
steps.text: Paste the diff into PR Reviewer - it leads with what can break, what is untested, and where context is thin.

steps.name: Loop
steps.text: Feed the fixes to Loops - a generalized engineering outer loop that keeps iterating build, test, repair.

name: Inbox & Calendar Desk
tagline: Triage, answer, follow through - the coordination desk.
description: The daily coordination pipeline. Inbot connects your mail, Slack, and calendars and triages what came in, Jess reads everything first and drafts the answers, and Dispatch closes the loop by turning agreed calls into actual calendar invites.

steps.name: Triage
steps.text: Connect Inbot to mail, Slack, Teams, and calendars - it sorts the overnight noise into what needs you.

steps.name: Answer
steps.text: Jess reads everything first, answers staff questions in your voice, and drafts what needs drafting.

steps.name: Follow through
steps.text: If a call was agreed but no invite exists, Dispatch creates the calendar event and closes the loop.

name: Money Hunters
tagline: Claim what's yours, cut the waste, spend smarter.
description: A quarterly money sweep with three real bots. Bounty Hunter digs up money that is already yours but unclaimed, AIUsageBot audits which AI subscriptions actually earn their keep, and Deal Hunting prices what you're about to buy with shipping and tax included.

steps.name: Claim
steps.text: Set Bounty Hunter loose on missed refunds, rebates, and unclaimed money - it goes looking on your behalf.

steps.name: Cut
steps.text: AIUsageBot interviews you about which AI subscriptions to keep, then pings you as usage drops before the next charge.

steps.name: Spend smarter
steps.text: Before a purchase, Deal Hunting prices the landed cost - real prices, shipping, and tax at your preferred retailer.

name: Research Desk
tagline: Scan, dig, stress-test - research with three different depths.
description: The analyst pipeline. Last30days tells you what people actually said about a topic in the past month, Research Bot reasons from first principles and refuses to hand back a sloppy answer, and Interrogator finds the assumptions your conclusion is quietly standing on.

steps.name: Scan
steps.text: Ask Last30days what people actually say about your topic right now - grounded in the last month of chatter.

steps.name: Dig
steps.text: Take the open questions to Research Bot - first-principles reasoning that refuses to hand back an answer without receipts.

steps.name: Stress-test
steps.text: Give your conclusion to Interrogator - it surfaces the assumptions you're operating on and checks whether they hold.

name: Sales Desk
tagline: Know your fans, write from proof, keep your voice.
description: A growth pipeline for anyone selling in public. X Top 500 Fans ranks who actually engages with you, Shorty starts every post from your proven performers instead of a blank page, and Human Copywriter rewrites anything that drifted off your voice.

steps.name: List
steps.text: X Top 500 Fans ranks your top 500 engagers each month - your real audience, not your follower count.

steps.name: Write
steps.text: Shorty starts from proven performers rather than everything you have posted - new content built on what already worked.

steps.name: Polish
steps.text: Human Copywriter rewrites email, posts, and landing pages in a human voice before anything ships.

name: Study Desk
tagline: Check, explain, go deep - homework to mastery.
description: The study pipeline. Homework Checker summarizes exactly what's outstanding and explains one problem properly, Lennybot answers product and growth questions from Lenny's Newsletter archive, and Research Bot takes you from summary to genuine understanding.

steps.name: Check
steps.text: Homework Checker produces an after-school summary of what's outstanding, plus a one-off explanation of the hard part.

steps.name: Understand
steps.text: Ask Lennybot - it answers product and growth questions from the Lenny's Data archive with citations.

steps.name: Go deep
steps.text: Research Bot takes the topic further - first-principles reasoning that shows its work.
